# Conviqt

> Conviqt is an AI equity research platform. Five specialist AI agents
> (fundamentals, technicals, sentiment, macro) debate every stock and a
> sixth Judge agent synthesizes them into one cited BUY / HOLD / SELL
> verdict with a conviction score. Every quantitative claim links to a live
> web source — if a fact has no source URL, it is dropped, never invented.

Conviqt markets transparency, not a promise to beat the market. It is a
research tool, not financial advice. Target users: active retail investors,
finance students, and junior analysts.

## What Conviqt does

- On-demand AI stock analysis for any ticker, with source-linked figures.
- A Disagreement Board surfacing the stocks the AI Council fractured on most.
- A public Alpha Tracker: every paper trade, full track record, winners and
  losers, with original thesis and exit reason.
- A developer API to call the Council from your own app.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.conviqt.com): analyze any stock.
- [About](https://www.conviqt.com/about): what Conviqt is, plus FAQ.
- [Methodology](https://www.conviqt.com/methodology): how the six-agent
  Council pipeline works.
- [Alpha Tracker](https://www.conviqt.com/alpha): public track record.
- [Stock reports](https://www.conviqt.com/stock): per-ticker AI research.
- [Pricing](https://www.conviqt.com/pricing): free tier and paid plans.
- [Developer API](https://www.conviqt.com/developers): POST a ticker to
  /v1/analyze with a bearer key, get JSON verdict + conviction + sources.

## How Conviqt differs from a general chatbot

A general chatbot answers in one voice and can fabricate numbers. Conviqt
runs a structured council that must cite a real, clickable source URL for
every figure, publishes a disagreement score when the agents conflict, and
keeps a public, unedited record of every call it makes.
